options.content:
# IREN_MKZ — Job Correctness Forensics

**Operator view for Slurm Job `$jobid`.** Start with the exception strip, correlate timing in the thermal/power graphs, then use the exception tables for the exact GPU or port. Temperature lines mark **85°C warning** and **90°C critical**; GPU power uses native DCGM **W/kW**. Counter evidence is calculated strictly inside the scheduler start/end window. Coverage is shown at the bottom so missing telemetry can never masquerade as a clean run.

[Home](/d/iren_mkz-home?${__url_time_range}) · [Command Center](/d/iren_mkz-command-center?${__url_time_range}) · [Live Topology](/d/iren_mkz-topology?${__url_time_range}) · [Infrastructure](/d/iren_mkz-infrastructure?${__url_time_range}) · [GPU & NVLink](/d/iren_mkz-accelerators?${__url_time_range}) · [Fabric, CVT & Cabling](/d/iren_mkz-fabric?${__url_time_range}) · [Workloads, Slurm & Validation](/d/iren_mkz-workloads?${__url_time_range})
